.dcmodal {

    content: '';
    position: absolute;
	z-index: 0;
	transform: rotate(45deg);
    width: 2.25rem;
    height: 2.25rem;
    bottom: 13em;
    right: -1.125rem;
	background-color: #ffffff;
}

    position: absolute;

    width: 2.25rem;
    height: 2.25rem;
    bottom: 13em;
    right: -1.125rem;
    z-index: -1;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 25%), 0 1px 5px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 25%), 0 3px 1px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 33%);
